name: io.github.gotoquill/gotoquill
title: gotoquill
description: Human-confirmed PDF signing. Local stdio via PyPI; hosted Cloud with OAuth.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends feedback the user explicitly chose to send to Gotoquill support and returns delivery status. Reports cannot be recalled. Accepts an issue description and optional email; document contents, signing links, passwords and signatures are outside the supported input.

assistant.description: Assistant name, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Le Chat, Muse, or Other

tools.name: open_signing_card
tools.description: Creates a pending signature request from an attached PDF or built-in sample and return a sign_url browser link with signing card metadata. Supported hosts may display the card for the human to review, sign and consent; the browser link also opens the signing UI. Without a usable PDF or sample, returns awaiting_pdf and upload_url for human upload. Returns immediately. Without a PDF, structuredContent.agent_upload provides a one-time PUT URL and authorization header for raw application/pdf bytes, max_bytes and expires_at. Upload returns JSON with sign_url. Credentials belong only in structured fields. Human browser upload_url remains available. Explicit ink placements are the complete field list; absent placements enable auto-detection, with signer_role available to disambiguate multiple parties. add_date adds a missing date only when true. sample: "nda" selects the built-in unsigned NDA for user-requested demonstrations without an attachment. A usable supplied PDF takes precedence over sample. The sample defaults to Party A; signer_role: "Party B" selects Party B.

offline_file.description: When true, returns a standalone signing HTML file as offline_signing_html within the inline budget, or offline_signing_url for download. The human reviews, signs and consents offline, then pastes the compact response code back for apply_signature_response. May be unavailable for large PDFs; sign_url remains available.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS URL to download the file

file.description: Attached PDF as a file object containing download_url and file_id.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS URL to download the file

pdf.description: Alias for `file` with the same file object shape.

pdf_base64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes, limited to 100,000 characters by the tool transport.

pdf_url.description: HTTPS download URL for a PDF.

sample.description: Built-in unsigned sample NDA; no attachment required. Intended for user-requested samples, tests or demos. A usable supplied PDF takes precedence over sample, and load errors remain errors. Defaults to Party A (left); signer_role: "Party B" selects the right column. Explicit ink placements override these defaults.

signer_name.description: Full name of the person signing (usually the user)

signer_role.description: For the built-in sample, Party A (left) is the default; Party B selects the right column. For other PDFs, only needed when placements are omitted and multiple parties cannot be resolved from signer_name. The value identifies a party heading (e.g. Party A). Ignored with explicit ink placements.

items.description: Ink box on the PDF. Coordinates use TOP-LEFT origin in PDF points (1/72"), with +y downward from the top of the page (Gotoquill converts to PDF bottom-left when stamping). Omitted placements are detected automatically. Explicit ink boxes define the complete list and are clamped to page bounds.

x.description: Left edge from the left of the page (PDF points)

y.description: Top edge from the TOP of the page (PDF points, top-left origin - NOT PDF bottom-left)

placements.description: Complete field list in top-left PDF points. An explicit list requires at least one signature or initials box. Explicit ink placements disable auto-detection and party inference; no detected fields are added. An absent list enables auto-detection.

add_date.description: When true, adds one date box if missing. False/omitted leaves explicit placements unchanged; a date already in placements is kept.

date_format.description: Numeric date default. The signer can override it; otherwise DD/MM/YYYY (en-US may use MM/DD/YYYY).

expires_in_minutes.description: Optional TTL in minutes. Default 10080 (7 days). Server minimum 60.

tools.name: request_signature
tools.description: Creates a pending PDF signature request and returns a sign_url browser link for human review, signing and consent. A signing card may also appear in supported hosts. If neither a usable PDF nor a sample option is supplied, returns an upload_url instead. The returned URL is shareable with the signer; this tool sends no email or notification. Expiration defaults to seven days, with a minimum of one hour. Without a PDF, structuredContent.agent_upload provides a one-time PUT URL and authorization header for raw application/pdf bytes, max_bytes and expires_at. Upload returns JSON with sign_url. Credentials belong only in structured fields. Human browser upload_url remains available. Explicit ink placements are the complete field list; absent placements enable auto-detection, with signer_role available to disambiguate multiple parties. add_date adds a missing date only when true. sample: "nda" selects the built-in unsigned NDA for user-requested demonstrations without an attachment. A usable supplied PDF takes precedence over sample. The sample defaults to Party A; signer_role: "Party B" selects Party B.

sample.description: Built-in unsigned sample NDA; no attachment required. Intended for user-requested samples, tests or demos. A usable supplied PDF takes precedence over sample, and load errors remain errors. Defaults to Party A (left); signer_role: "Party B" selects the right column. Explicit ink placements override these defaults.

tools.name: get_signature_status
tools.description: Reads the stored signature status for request_id and returns its signed PDF link without changing the request. Mailbox submissions are applied on receipt. Returns immediately by default; optional wait_seconds is capped at three seconds.

include_base64.description: Includes signed PDF base64 within the inline budget; larger files return signed_pdf_url and inline_omitted_reason. Omitted by default.

tools.name: wait_for_signature
tools.description: Reads whether request_id is final without changing it and returns the signed PDF link when completed. Returns immediately by default; optional wait_seconds is capped at three seconds.

include_base64.description: Includes signed PDF base64 within the inline budget; larger files return signed_pdf_url and inline_omitted_reason. Omitted by default.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Cancels the request identified by request_id, removes pending signing data and returns its final status. A repeated cancellation preserves that status.

tools.name: apply_signature_response
tools.description: Applies an encrypted signer response from the signing UI to request_id, including an offline GOTOQUILL1 code. Returns the completed or declined status and signed PDF link when completed. Signing requires explicit human consent in the UI.

tools.name: sign_in_chat
tools.description: Submits an encrypted signer response for request_id produced by the signing card after human consent, returning status and the completed PDF link. Without a response, returns the pending signing link. Raw consent, names and images cannot authorize completion.

tools.name: ui_load_document
tools.description: Loads the owned request_id status and PDF preview: original bytes while pending and signed bytes after completion. Optional offset and length return bounded byte chunks; an unchunked PDF above 49,152 bytes returns a preview link.

offset.description: Byte offset for bounded preview transport

length.description: Chunk bytes (base64 result at most 64 KiB)
